notes.title: New DEMO Version
notes.content:
[b]CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed the Soldo upgrade from the Order List
[*] New upgrade implemented: Life Steal
[*] New upgrade implemented: Critical Hit
[*] Fixed tower attack bugs
[*] The game no longer pauses in the background
[*] Enemy balancing
[*] Other minor bugs fixed
[/list]

[i]Thanks to everyone who has been reporting bugs and suggesting improvements for the game![/i]
